Hi Laura, Andreas — tagging operational details:  

Short version: we prefer to receive the full contracted EUR amount (i.e., sender covers intermediary charges), but we can accept net settlement and then reconcile the shortfall via invoice adjustment if needed. 

Details / options (practical):
- Payment instructions: please instruct your bank to send charges as "SHA" or "OUR". If sent as "SHA" we typically see small deductions (15–45 EUR) depending on the correspondent corridor.
- If Treasury cannot force OUR/SHA and it arrives net of intermediary fees we will:
   a) Post payment to the invoice for the net received amount;
   b) Raise a short-pay memo to your AP and request reimbursement for the deducted amount (we can issue a separate debit memo or a short invoice).

Recommended field to include on the transfer: 
  Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltd
  IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00
  BIC/SWIFT: COBADEFFXXX
  Reference: REDW-202806 / EuroTech PO 4472

If the payment route requires an intermediary bank, the intermediary may show on your bank's routing advice as a "Correspondent" or "Intermediary"—those charges are typically outside the MT103 beneficiary fields and will be deducted before posting. I attached a short plain-text copy of our wire instructions to reduce copying errors.

Also: VAT ID confirmed by Laura is DE320987654 — we will issue a corrected invoice with VAT fields populated and resend before EOD tomorrow.
